pages.summary: Jane muestra la habitación de invitados. Cuando Pansy se queda sola, aparece Crookshanks.

panels.scene: Upstairs landing with oak railing and small warm wall lamps. Jane in sage cardigan gently transfers one Robin to Hermione in burgundy sweater, both supporting the bundled baby. Pansy in forest-green vest, long white sleeves and charcoal trousers follows one step away.
dialogue: Jane: Espero que estés cómoda.

panels.scene: Wide view of the compact cozy guest room, Jane opens the door, Pansy takes in the forest green bed, reading chair, books, lamp, water and tiny pine decoration. Hermione carries Robin at the threshold.
panels.caption: Habían pensado en su llegada.

panels.scene: Jane and Pansy face each other from a friendly distance. Jane in sage cardigan, Pansy green vest, white sleeves and green-silver school tie, Pansy’s arms relaxed.
dialogue: Pansy: Gracias, señora Granger.
Jane: Jane. Si vas a pasar la Navidad aquí, llámame Jane.

panels.scene: View of two separate upstairs doorways. Jane has left frame. Hermione carrying sleepy Robin steps toward the adjacent bedroom, Pansy near her guest door, slightly hesitant but smiles.
dialogue: Pansy: No tardes demasiado.
Hermione: No lo haré.

panels.scene: Pansy alone in the reading chair, straightening the top book on the stack. She wears a dark green vest, green-silver tie, long white sleeves and dark gray trousers. Her coat and gloves stay downstairs. A subtle movement of the door behind her.
panels.caption: Por fin pudo respirar.

panels.scene: At floor height, the guest room door opens a little. One very large fluffy ginger cat enters, thick brush tail and yellow eyes, surveying Pansy. Pansy's olive vest and dark trousers visible seated to the far right, no other human in frame.

pages.summary: Malcolm trae un baúl y hace sentir bienvenida a Pansy. Crookshanks decide que el equipaje es suyo.

panels.scene: Eye-level view at the guest room doorway. Malcolm in navy V-neck and rectangular glasses carries one large dark trunk with two visible natural hands. Pansy looks up from the reading chair. Crookshanks waits on the rug, one cat only.
dialogue: Malcolm: Creo que has traído la mitad de Hogwarts.

panels.scene: Malcolm has set the trunk at foot of bed and straightens up, his hand relaxed at hip. Pansy stands clear of him, one eyebrow raised, green vest and white sleeves.
dialogue: Pansy: Solo traje lo indispensable.

panels.scene: Warm close view of Malcolm at the open door, a genuine smile. Pansy in foreground listens, a surprised soft expression.
dialogue: Malcolm: Estás en tu casa, Pansy. Descansa hasta la cena.

panels.scene: Low wide view after Malcolm leaves. Big ginger Crookshanks lands on the closed trunk and curls his brushy tail around his paws. Pansy stands at a safe distance, hands resting naturally at her hips.
panels.caption: El gato tenía otras ideas sobre quién mandaba en la habitación.

panels.scene: The cat lies on its side, yawning with unmistakably feline anatomy. Pansy leans forward a little to speak, arms lowered.
dialogue: Pansy: Ese baúl es mío, Crookshanks.

panels.scene: At the door Hermione has changed into gray loungewear and holds sleepy Robin with two natural supporting arms. He wears full cream lion-print pajamas. Pansy turns toward her, Crookshanks still on trunk.
dialogue: Hermione: Crookshanks solo te está dando la bienvenida.

pages.summary: Pansy admite que se siente a gusto en casa de Hermione. Crookshanks abandona el baúl y se instala cerca de ellas.

panels.scene: Hermione sits upright on the edge of the green guest bed, gray sweatshirt and full trousers, supporting sleepy Robin. Pansy stands by the brass trunk, looking skeptically at Crookshanks sprawled across its lid.
dialogue: Pansy: Me está juzgando.
Hermione: Es mitad kneazle. Dale tiempo.

panels.scene: Close Robin's tiny fingers closing around Pansy’s offered index finger, skin smooth and fully human, one lion-print cuff and Pansy’s white cuff visible. Hermione supports him, face partly visible.
panels.caption: Robin le apretó el dedo y Pansy bajó la voz.

panels.scene: Pansy at reading chair holds an old green hardback. The gold letters on the plain cover say exactly JANE AUSTEN. Hermione looks on from bed, Robin asleep.
dialogue: Pansy: Tu madre tiene buen gusto. Me agrada.

panels.scene: Pansy sets the book gently back on the small stack, eyes drifting toward the oak hallway. Hermione smiles, still holds Robin.
dialogue: Pansy: Tu padre todavía me está evaluando.
Hermione: Se rio contigo en el coche. Le agradas.

panels.scene: Pansy sits near Hermione on edge of bed. Their faces relaxed, shoulders close, fully dressed. One Robin in Hermione’s arms, quiet green duvet and lamp.
dialogue: Pansy: La casa también me agrada. Es cálida.

panels.scene: Crookshanks has crossed from trunk to the far foot of the bed. One ginger cat settles on green duvet well away from Robin, curled tail. Pansy smiles faintly and Hermione looks toward the cat.
dialogue: Hermione: ¿Ves? Ya está empezando a aceptarte.

Capítulo 12 · 19

En la cena, Pansy explica los encantamientos del Zephyr y descubre el interés de Malcolm por la magia.
Narración: Antes de cenar, Pansy sacó el Zephyr del baúl de Robin.
Narración: En el comedor sonaba jazz.
Malcolm: No ha abierto los ojos desde que bajaron.
Pansy: El Zephyr tiene un encantamiento que suaviza los ruidos fuertes.
Malcolm: ¿Y la temperatura se regula como un termostato?
Pansy: Parecido, pero más preciso.
Malcolm: Es una compra excelente, Pansy.
pages.review: El Zephyr arena y dorado sale vacío del baúl mientras Hermione sostiene a Robin. En la cena Robin está en su cochecito y se conservan cuatro personas, los diálogos y el mobiliario.
